note: Micro-benchmark on tiny models (3-60 elements). NPU advantage requires larger models. See Phase 2 for real workloads.
observation: For tiny models (<100 elements), NPU overhead dominates: NPU ~0.32-0.37ms vs CPU ~0.14-0.17ms. NPU advantage expected at larger tensor sizes (MobileNetV2, YOLO). Phase 2 will test with real vision models.
